'''Kanjon Slyke's brother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal just like his brother [[Kanjon Slyke]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the two were caught by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and sent to a [[Belsavis prison]]. While imprisoned, Slyke's brother attempted to break into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by its security systems.<ref name="TOR" />
